unmatched.m: Of the remaining member of a pair.

unmeaning.e: Silence is better than unmeaning words.

unmeasured.m: Not composed of measured syllables; not metrical.

unmechanised.e: Production of furniture remained largely unmechanised.

unmediated.m: Having no intervening persons, agents, conditions.

unmelodious.m: Not having a musical sound or pleasing tune.
